summary: Axos Financial subsidiary Axos Bank closed its purchase of roughly $1.9 billion of Capital One individual retirement account deposits tied to savings and CD accounts. The parties signed a Purchase and Assumption Agreement on April 22, 2026, and the deal closed September 21, 2026. The bank paid cash for the aggregate deposit balance less a negotiated premium. No board recommendation or advisor is named, and no shareholder vote was required. The deposit transfer is a business-line asset purchase rather than a whole-company merger, so no target equity remains outstanding. Watch the negotiated premium and retention of the acquired IRA deposits.
